intent: Record the ingest rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context ingest lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A generation's task description counts characters, not bytes: one shorter than 8 characters without a diagram is refused as blank, one longer than 4000 is refused as too long, and both bounds themselves are accepted; with no description, a diagram is required.
A diagram attached to a generation must be a non-empty image of an allowed type and at most 4,000,000 bytes; a diagram of exactly that size is accepted.
A generation names at most three reference skills; three are accepted and four are refused before the gateway.
The catalogue workspace never generates skills; a generation request in it is refused before anything else is checked.

A workspace holds at most one generation at a time across every API instance: a second request while a lease is live is refused as in flight, another workspace is unaffected, and an expired lease can be taken over.
